notes.title: I’LL FUCK YOUR GRANDPA! Still insane. Just smoother. 😈
notes.content:
Nothing can prepare you for this — and now it plays even better. Our latest update smooths out the experience with better scene handling, lighter transitions, and sharper timing.

We’re keeping the madness alive while making sure you can enjoy every moment without interruption. Grandpa's still got it — and so do we.
